capture.implicitMetadataMethod: strace -f -e trace=%file; resolve successful open/openat against observed shared descriptor directory map; match all compiler onLoad bytes and metafile inputs; hash all opened regular repository/package files after build
limitations: Syscall capture proves successful file opens, not exact read ranges. All opened repository/package bytes are conservatively hashed in full.

Build source bytes are pinned before supplying them via onLoad and rehashed after build. Implicit resolution metadata is hashed after build; clean immutable tracked state and installed frozen preparation support stability, but no hostile concurrent mutation proof is claimed.
Compiler environmental reads (/proc, /sys, dynamic linker runtime and timezone) are inventoried separately; they are not repository/module resolution inputs.
Failed path probes remain in the full strace log and can affect resolution; no network or current WIP source/module input is allowed.
Metafile outputs.imports is empty despite static built-in imports; emitted imports are independently obtained using Bun.Transpiler.scanImports.
